slots.notes: Brand mark for the LogoIcon sub-component: an 18x18 inline SVG (a swoosh path filled white plus a 2px white round-cap stroke) centered inside a w-8 h-8 rounded-[8px] box filled with the accent color (#31A8FF). Sits left of the 'vize' wordmark in the brand column. The glyph itself is solid white-on-accent, so the socket needs a single-color mark that reads on the accent tile; swap the path data and the tile fill together per brand.

Three social glyphs (Linkedin, Twitter, Instagram from lucide-react) rendered at w-5 h-5 (size 20) with text-slate-800, each inside a 44x44 white rounded-xl button (border-slate-100, soft shadow, hover:bg-slate-50, active:scale-95). Replace with the brand's actual social set; glyphs inherit currentColor so they tint to the fg/dark-slate value.

Inter (weights 300/400/500/600/700) loaded from Google Fonts and wired to Tailwind --font-sans via @theme; carries the entire footer — the 'vize' wordmark, column headings, links, legal microcopy, AND the giant background 'vize' GlassText element whose composition depends on this face's bold metrics.

mechanic: A premium layered footer card (gray #E9EBEE rounded-[48px] body wrapping a white rounded-[40px] inner box over a 5-column brand/Product/Science/Company link grid plus a bottom legal bar) stacked above a massive 'vize' wordmark rendered as white text pushed through a handcrafted multi-stage feMerge SVG filter (outer drop-shadow + inner white and inner black inset-shadow masks) that fades and scales in on view (opacity 0->1, scale 0.98->1) via motion/react whileInView.
techDelivery: Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 (@import "tailwindcss" with an @theme --font-sans and @layer utilities glass-card / text-glass / liquid-glass) + motion/react animation + lucide-react icons, authored in TypeScript as src/index.css, src/App.tsx, and src/components/Footer.tsx (LogoIcon + FooterCard + GlassText + default Footer).
reskinNotes: The signature GlassText effect is a fully hardcoded inline SVG filter (id="glass-effect"): the feDropShadow and the two inner-shadow feFlood stages bake in literal floodColor #000000 / #ffffff at floodOpacity 0.25, so retinting the glass means editing those filter primitives, not flipping a token. The giant wordmark sizing is text-[min(25vw,400px)] font-bold leading-none tuned to Inter Bold metrics — a wider or taller display face will overflow or break the composition. The LogoIcon is inline white SVG path data on a literal bg-[#31A8FF] tile (must be swapped as a pair per brand). Palette is light-theme only and spread as literal hex across markup (body #F9F9FB on #141414, App wrapper #F0F1F3, card #E9EBEE/white, headings #0F172A, muted #64748B and #94A3B8, links #1E293B hover #31A8FF, separators slate-200/slate-300) rather than centralized tokens. The .glass-card/.liquid-glass utilities are white-rgba baked CSS (the liquid-glass ::before is a mask-composite gradient border). ALL copy is hardcoded in JSX: the 'vize' wordmark (twice — brand row and the background GlassText), the marketing description, the three column headings (Product/Science/Company) and every link label (Features/Solutions/Pricing/Updates, Approach/Identity/Research/Metrics, About Us/Partners/Careers), the '(c) 2025 Vize. All rights reserved.' line, and the Legal Center / User Agreement links.
